description: Defines the SimpleCommand class, a JSON-serializable command object with command name, optional correlation ID, and optional payload, including methods for creation, JSON conversion, and equality checks.

classes.name: SimpleCommand
classes.description: A JSONifiable class representing a command with a name, optional correlation ID, and optional payload.

classes.name: SimpleCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions for JSON fields used in SimpleCommand: command name, correlation ID, and payload.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.of
methods.description: Creates a new SimpleCommand instance with specified command name, correlation ID, and payload.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SimpleCommand from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.toJson
methods.description: Converts the SimpleCommand to a JSON object.
